title: Remap a misreported controller with SDL Raw Input on Windows
summary: Use SDL Raw Input as a Windows fallback when a third-party pad reports scrambled or unresponsive controls, and map each physical input manually.
heroAlt: A Logitech game controller viewed from above.
author: EmuCore - Hub

blocks.text: PCSX2 notes that some third-party controllers reuse another device’s identifier while presenting a different button layout. Automatic mapping can then place the wrong physical controls on PS2 actions. On Windows, SDL Raw Input can correct some of these cases, but PCSX2 says its automatic mapper does not use the raw inputs; the affected pad must be mapped manually.

This option is a Windows-only troubleshooting step. First confirm the controller is detected and record the working mapping, if any. Use an in-game menu or a legal PS2 pad-testing homebrew utility for the check; never map buttons by guessing while a save-sensitive game is in progress.

items: 1. Open Settings > Controllers and select SDL as the input source.
2. Enable SDL Raw Input, then choose the affected controller port.
3. Use Clear Mapping for that port only so old automatic bindings cannot mask the raw inputs.
4. Select each PS2 control in the UI, press its intended physical button, and repeat for both sticks and triggers.
5. Check the mapping list before starting a game; confirm no physical input is assigned to two unintended PS2 actions.
6. Launch a safe menu or pad test and press each mapped control separately, including diagonals and stick centers.

blocks.text: The mapping passes when every intended button activates its matching PS2 input once, both sticks return to neutral, and no neighboring button fires. A normal game menu is enough to verify common controls; use a pad test for inputs the title does not expose.

items: Automatic Mapping appears wrong: this is expected with SDL Raw Input; clear and map inputs manually.
A control is still silent: check that the correct SDL device and port are selected and test the physical pad outside the game.
Two actions fire together: remove the duplicate assignment from this port and repeat the test.
The pad is not detected: disable Raw Input and try another supported input source before changing the game profile.

blocks.text: Close the game, disable SDL Raw Input, and restore the recorded mapping or previous input source. Reopen the same safe test and verify the controller returns to its prior behavior. Do not remove device drivers or delete emulator configuration to undo a single mapping experiment.
